# Space Station 14
Welcome to the pre-alpha of Space Station 14! We hope you enjoy the game, and this entry will serve to guide you on how to learn to play. There's quite a bit to read, but SS14 is in itself a very large and in-depth game, and hopefully these guides help you enjoy it to it's fullest.
## What this is Space Station 14 is a free (forever) open source remake of the infamous Space Station 13, hoping to provide an improved experience for both newcomers and old players alike. Space Station 14 is designed as a fully moddable experience that you can modify to your liking with custom servers, adding entire swaths of new content for people to explore.
If you're just here to play, that's great! The [color=#a4885c]Where to start[/color] section of this entry will help you out, if you're looking to do a bit more with the game, you can join our discord and find our github page in the lobby.
## Where to start This section is a general Space Station 14 reference. It is kept for the vanilla pages that in-game items link to, so some of it describes standard station play rather than Taypan.
If this is your first round here, start in the [bold]Hullrot: Eclipsion[/bold] section instead, with [textlink="Start Here: Your First Round" link="GettingStarted"].
Otherwise, the useful pages below are [textlink="Controls" link="Controls"] for interface and interaction basics, [textlink="Jobs" link="Jobs"] for the standard station departments, [textlink="Survival" link="Survival"] for damage and emergencies, and [textlink="Species" link="Species"] for what each species can and cannot do. Not all jobs or concepts have guides yet, and it's strongly encouraged to help us write them if you're an experienced player!
